Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Porter now accepts any incoming trade partner whose displayed name matches a prepared awaiting winner, without requiring a prior greeting. Transient prize-placement readiness is retried instead of cancelling immediately. Greeting reminders now run every minute, escalating on the second and third calls.
